lines.en: Layla is a student. She's from Damascus.
Every day she goes to the university.

lines.text: بِتحِبّ القَهوة كْتير، بَس بَلا سُكَّر.
lines.tr: btḥibb il-ʔahwe ktīr, bass bala sukkar.
lines.en: She loves coffee a lot, but without sugar.
Today there's no coffee at the university!

lines.text: ليلى بِتِشرَب شاي. الشّاي مْنيح، بَس مِش قَهوة.
lines.tr: Layla btishrab shāy. ish-shāy mnīḥ, bass mish ʔahwe.
lines.en: Layla drinks tea. The tea is fine, but it's not coffee.
Oh well, never mind.
Yesterday Venu had an exam.

lines.text: صِحي الصُّبح، وشِرِب قَهوة، ورَاح عالجامْعة.
lines.tr: ṣiḥi iṣ-ṣubḥ, w shirib ʔahwe, w rāḥ ʕal-jāmʕa.
lines.en: He woke up in the morning, drank coffee and went to the university.
The exam was a bit hard.
There was a question he didn't know the answer to.
After the exam, he talked with the teacher.
The teacher said: it's fine, it was good!
At night, Venu slept very well.
Grandma and Grandpa's house is in Damascus.

lines.text: البَيت قَديم وكْبير، وفي أوضة زْغيرة فوق.
lines.tr: il-bēt ʔadīm w kbīr, w fī ʔūḍa zghīre fōʔ.
lines.en: The house is old and big, and there's a small room upstairs.

lines.text: كِل يَوم الجُمعة، كِل العيلة بِتِجي.
lines.tr: kill yōm il-jimʕa, kill il-ʕēle btiji.
lines.en: Every Friday, the whole family comes.
Grandma makes very tasty food.
Grandpa talks about old Damascus.

lines.text: الوْلاد بيِشربو عَصير، والكْبار بيِشربو قَهوة.
lines.tr: il-wlād byishrabu ʕaṣīr, wil-kbār byishrabu ʔahwe.
lines.en: The kids drink juice, and the grown-ups drink coffee.
I love Grandma's house a lot.
Sara is a doctor at the hospital.
Today there are a lot of patients.

lines.text: واحِد عِندو وَجَع راس، ووحدة إيدا بِتوجَعا.
lines.tr: wāḥad ʕindo wajaʕ rās, w waḥde ʔīda btūjaʕa.
lines.en: One has a headache, and one's hand hurts.

lines.text: وَلَد زْغير عِندو حَرارة مِن مْبارِح.
lines.tr: walad zghīr ʕindo ḥarāra min mbāriḥ.
lines.en: A little boy has had a fever since yesterday.
Sara checks blood pressure and heart.
She gives medicine and says: get well soon!

lines.text: بِالمَسا، سارة تَعبانة كْتير، بَس مَبسوطة.
lines.tr: bil-masa, Sāra taʕbāne ktīr, bass mabsūṭa.
lines.en: In the evening, Sara is very tired, but happy.

lines.text: بَعد شَهر، فينو رَح يسافِر عَلى بيروت.
lines.tr: baʕd shahr, Venu raḥ ysāfir ʕala Bēirūt.
lines.en: In a month, Venu will travel to Beirut.

lines.text: رَح ياخُد تَكسي مِن المَطار عالأوتيل.
lines.tr: raḥ yākhud taksi min il-maṭār ʕal-ʔōtēl.
lines.en: He'll take a taxi from the airport to the hotel.
The hotel is close to the sea.
His friend Rami lives there.

lines.text: رَح يِشربو قَهوة، ويِحكو عَرَبي كْتير.
lines.tr: raḥ yishrabu ʔahwe, w yiḥku ʕarabi ktīr.
lines.en: They'll drink coffee and speak a lot of Arabic.
Venu has to study before the trip.

lines.text: بِدّو يِفهَم كِل شي، إن شاء الله!
lines.en: He wants to understand everything, hopefully!
